paite: Huchibang a muanhuaitak a thil ahih nung un Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Judah gam ah ahong lut a, kulh nei khuate ahong um a, lak ahong tum hi.
heading: Assuriate'n Jerusalem Akhemlau Uh / (2 Kum 18.13-37; 19.14-19,35-37; Isa 36.1-22; 37.8-38)

paite: Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Jerusalem hong sual atum chih Hezekiah in atheih in,
kho polam a tuite hihtat ding in amiliante leh amihatte athuhilh a; huchi in apanpih uhi.
Huchi in mi tampi akikaikhawm ua, tui tengteng leh gamsung a luangsuak luite achingtan ua, Assuria kumpipate ahong lut ua, "Tui tampi bang ding in ahong nei mahmah ding ua," achi uhi.
Huchi in akihangsak ua, kulh chipna tata abawl a, insungte leh polam kulhte leng abawlhoih hi. David khua ah Millo ahihkip a, galvante leh lumte tampi abawl hi.
Kidouna a mipi heutute abawl a, khopi kongkhak mun za lai ah asamkhawm hi.
"Hattak in, hangsantak in om unla, Assuria kumpipa leh aheute mipi lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un:
Amah lam a pangsa sepaih ahi ua, ei hon panpih ding leh hon dousak ding a ei lam a pang bel TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in lungmuanna thu agen hi.
Huai nung in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in; amah leh asepaihte Lakish ah a-om ua, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a Judah mi tengteng kiang ah,
"Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in hichi in achi, Jerusalem lak bang ahia na uplouhna uh?
Hezekiah in, TOUPA i Pathian in Assuria kumpipa khut a kipan hon hunkhe ding, chi in gilkial leh dangtak a na sihna ding un ahon khem ahi kei maw?
Hezekiah mah ahi kei maw, amun sangte leh amaitamte chimsak a Judah mi leh Jerusalem a mite kiang a, maitam khat ah Pathian na be ding ua, gimlim na hal ding uh, chi a thu pepa?
Kei leh ka pute'n gamdang mite tung a ka thilhih uh na thei kei ua hia?
"Kua namte pathian ahia ka pute'n ahihman uh ka khut a kipan a amite uh hunkhe thei om a, noute Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan a ahon hutkhiak theih tuamna ding?

Huaiziak in Hezekiah in hon khem kei henla, huchibang in hon khem kei henla, amah um kei un; bang nam pathian leh bang gam pathian himhim amite uh ka khut a kipan leh ka pute khut a kipan hunkhe thei a-om kei ua; bangchi in na Pathian un ka khut a kipan a hon hunkhe thei tuam mahmah dia?" chi in Jerusalem ah amite asawl hi.
Huan amite'n huai sang a thupi in TOUPA Pathian leh asikha Hezekiah tungtang thu ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.

Israelte' TOUPA Pathian hehsak ding leh gense ding in lai agelh lai hi. "Gam chih, namte pathiante'n ka khut a kipan amite uh hunkhe thei lou bangmah in Hezekiah Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan amite ahunkhe kei hial ding," chi in.
Khua alaktheihna ding un amulkimsakna ding leh lungzinsakna ding in Jerusalem a kulh a omte Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikoukhum uhi.
Jerusalem Pathian mihing khut a bawl leitung mite pathian bang lel phet in agen uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah leh Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai huaiziak in athum ua, van a om asam uhi.

TOUPA'N angel asawl a, huai in Assuria kumpipa giahmun a mihat hangsan tengteng leh makai heutute athat hi. Huchi in zum mahmah melpu in agam lam ah apai nawnta hi. Huan apathian inn a hoh lai ama tapate mahmah in namsau in athat uhi.
Huchibang in TOUPA'N Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a mite Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib khut a kipan leh midang tengteng khut a kipan ahumbit a, akim ua mite lak ah aveng hi.
Huan mi tampi in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in thilpiak ahon tawi ua, thil manpha pipite Judah kumpipa Hezekiah ahong pia ua; huai a kipan in nam chih mitmuh in pahtawi in a-omta hi.
Huai lai in Hezekiah bel sizou ding khop in achina a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a: huan, adawng a, chiamtehna apia hi.
heading: Hezekiah Damlouhna Leh Kisaktheihna / (2 Kum 20.1-3,12-19; Isa 38.1-3; 39.1-8)

paite: Himahleh Hezekiah in amah a ding a hoih kihih dungzui in ahih kei a, alungtang hong kisaktheih ziak in ahi; huaiziak in atung ah leh Judahte leh Jerusalem tung ah hehna ahong tung hi.
Himahleh Hezekiah in alungtang kisaktheihna kisik in akiniamkhiak nawn a, amah leh Jerusalem a mite toh; huchi in Hezekiah damsung in TOUPA hehna atung uah ahong tung kei hi.
Huan Hezekiah in sum-le-pai ahau a, athupita mahmah a; dangkasik, dangka-eng, suangmantam, gimlim, lum leh tui-um belsuan hoih pipi koihkhawmna inn alam hi.
heading: Hezekiah Hauhna Leh Thupina / (2 Kum 20.12-19; Isa 39.1-8)

paite: Buh, uain leh thau koihkhawmna inn leng alam lai a; gan chiteng koihna leh belam huang leng abawl hi.
Huchi in khuate leng abawl lai a, belamhon leh bawnghon ahau mahmah hi. Pathian in neizoutak in abawl hi.
Hezekiah mah in Gihon luitui saknungzaw pen ahubing a, David khua tumlam pang ah aluangkhesak hi. Huchi in Hezekiah athilhih tengteng ah alamzang zel hi.
Babulon miliante'n palai asawl ua agam a thillamdang adot thu uah alungtang a om tengteng atheihtheihna ding in Pathian in anusia in aze-et hi.
Hezekiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, ngai dih, Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kilakna bu, Judah kumpipa leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
heading: Hezekiah Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (2 Kum 20.20,21)

paite: Api-le-pute kiang ah Hezekiah a-ihmu a, David tapate hanmun paitouhna ah avui ua; Judah tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n asih ni in thupitak in agal uhi. Asik in atapa Manasseh in vai ahawmta hi.
